subject: Initialize one variable in struct to avoid risk (#1606)
reason: The change only adds `server.cluster->failover_auth_sent = 0` in clusterInit as defensive initialization. On every reachable path the field was already written before being read: the read at cluster_legacy.c:3220 is short-circuited by failover_auth_time (initialized to 0 and set non-zero only in the election-reset block that also zeroes failover_auth_sent), and the reads at lines 4824/4857 are only reached after that reset block has run, since on the first call failover_auth_time is 0 and auth_age therefore always exceeds auth_retry_time. No observable behavior — election timing, votes, failov
